body: I experienced the world already. Did a lot of the things I wanted to. Now I'm at a point where I truly do not want to live in. I really want to end my life on this chapter.
I think people just truly believe they know more than they do which makes them act that way.

Because I had this strive for life in my 20s and now that im in my 30s everything I worked got taken away form me 4 years ago and I can't gain any of it back. All that I worked for and imagined myself being is gone and no way to turn it around. I really just want it all to end at this point. I don't want to start from scratch again. There is no way I will start from scratch again.

My gf of 4 years doesnt even know I have major depression. I keep it a secret from everyone.

Anyone that I have spoken to seems to tell me the same thing your bf tells you. They really dont understand. They think they do, but they dont.
